statement: For both marked Q1920 tuples, the dimension-20 A-centralizer twist of the natural Omega8+(2) module has no nonidentity collision operator on two repeated copies
marked_Q_image: Q=2^5:A5 of order 1920 in the singular parabolic of Omega8+(2)
A_module_restriction: 1^4 + U^2, where U is the simple two-dimensional F2[S3]-module

encoding.method: direct Boolean circuit for matrix multiplication over F2, followed by audited AND/XOR Tseitin gates
encoding.witness_policy: Any SAT assignment is substituted back into the separately expanded source ANF before acceptance

scope: This is an exact multiplicity-two exclusion only. It does not imply the arbitrary-multiplicity Type-B theorem.
